title: Closing thanks and La Rocca reads 'Prejudice Blocks Out the Truth'
summary: Rust ends; La Rocca reads an article on prejudice and says he has tried to tell the truth.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: hope that the talk which i've given will be of some interest to those who hear it

i would like to read into this tape an article that i had read many years ago it's entitled prejudice blocks out the truth it begins this way prejudice is mud in the hands of mean and narrow men searching for a target and the target is the truth these men cannot see the truth it is obscured by their prejudice where judgment is weak prejudice is always strong it is hard to live without prejudice as it is to sleep with dogs without collecting fleas in chelan intelligent men always seek the truth but too often reach conviction before they reach truth and their convictions become prejudice and they close their minds to the opinion of other men who search for the truth by different path unfortunately there's more money and fame exploiting prejudice very little money in seeking the truth as in politics and literary action a man wins friends for himself mostly by passion of his prejudice and by his consistent narrowness of his outlook hitler and stalling preach hate and one day follows look where it got them and their followers upon every hill where men pay bit pay tribute to truth there you will find other men of mean minds willing the black paint of prejudice to obscure clean truth i have tried to tell the truth but they've always obscured the truth they never have wondered to go back and look into the dates that i have given them and the efforts of the oily negroes all you have to do is study their recordings and you'll know that i have told the truth that's all i have to say on this record 된된
